screenshots.description: PAS Health (Patient Access Solutions / ORBIT by IGI Infotech Global) EHR 'Eligibility > Inquiry' screen. Full application view: header with PAS Health.com logo, top toolbar (Add Patient, Patient Search, My Patient List, Message Center), and green nav tabs (Profile, Health Tracker, Dental & Vision, Medical Care, Medications, Data Exchange, E-Prescription, Eligibility, Claims). Patient banner shows patient name Michael Aghastien; demographics in form include Patient Last Name Aghastien, First Name Michael, DOB 01/20/1979, SSN 123456789, Gender Male. Demo/test patient.
